verdict.rationale: USPTO says it guides filers step by step and addresses self-filers. Its own pages say "we guide you through every step of the application process" and offer "File a patent application on your own" with a first-time-filer pilot. It also publishes pre-filing advice, a quick IP assessment, and application-timeline explainers. Most of the evidence is page headings and navigation labels, so it is unproven how deep or how plain-language these explainers are. Missing for 10: verbatim plain-language step-by-step explainer content, task-level walkthroughs beyond link titles, and independent or hands-on confirmation that a non-lawyer can follow them.

support.subject: As a founder, the service publishes plain-language, step-by-step guidance for my task — explainers a non-lawyer can follow, not just statute text and form numbers
